electron-native-notify NPM package adds remote backdoor

Target: electron-native-notify
Repository: https://github.com/calvinwyoung/electron-native-notify
Date: 2018-08-01
Attribution: Individual Hacker
Component: Library
Language: Javascript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Unauthorized Access/Control
Transitive: true
Impact Type: Backdoor/Remote Code Execution
User Impact:
Domain: npmjs.org (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The 'electron-native-notify' package was compromised to include malicious code. This code opened a reverse shell back to the attacker's server. It was used as a dependency in other applications, such as the Agama cryptocurrency wallet, leading to transitive compromises.
